audience: teams that keep records in Ragic sheets and forms

useCases.title: Find records by a field value
useCases.text: Read the field ids of a sheet, then list its records with a filter on one field.

useCases.title: Read one record in full
useCases.text: Open one record by its record id to read all of its top-level fields.

useCases.title: Create a record from a note
useCases.text: Create a record in a sheet from the field values you pass, such as a lead taken from a note.

useCases.title: Correct fields of a record
useCases.text: Change the top-level fields you pass in one record. Other fields and subtable rows stay as they are.

useCases.title: Lock a record against edits
useCases.text: Lock a record so users cannot edit it, or unlock it again. The Ragic form rules apply.
